bundle.shortDescription: Download videos and music from the web
bundle.longDescription: HyperStream downloads videos, music and playlists from YouTube and hundreds of other sites, with quality, audio-language and subtitle choices, a download queue, a built-in browser for sites that need a sign-in, and a local media library.
